# PROCESS — cand_0002 (parent: seed; cand_0001 was rejected/reverted)

All 21 failing tasks produced an output file whose values didn't match — no environment fault
(val 0.580 carries real capability signal). Diagnosed all 21 failing trajectories + the 8 key
passing tasks with 5 parallel read-only subagents (4 failure batches + 1 regression-analysis
batch on the tasks cand_0001 broke). Edits live ONLY in task_template.md; prompt.md untouched.

## Why cand_0001 was rejected (built on its RESULT: fixed={47741,59259} broke={50051,73-45})
Regression-analysis subagent traced the two breaks to two specific edits, which I did NOT re-add:
- **50051 (broke):** the prompt.md **anti-fabrication bullet** ("apply only stated operations,
  don't invent extra transforms") reframed 50051's *corrective re-derivation from raw columns*
  as a forbidden invented transform, pushing it to reproduce the buggy cached array-formula
  value. -> DROPPED entirely; prompt.md left unchanged.
- **73-45 (broke):** the unscoped **"if the answer is TEXT keep it a plain string"** type rule
  (+ verify type-recheck) told the agent BD free-text -> plain string, flattening a RICH-TEXT
  answer. -> NOT re-added in global form; the text rule is now scoped strictly to "a piece you
  SPLIT/EXTRACT out of a text cell", and the seed's rich-text-preservation bullet is kept intact.
The parts that FIXED {47741,59259} — the recalc-to-literal block and the example-reproduction
verify check — broke nothing, so I re-introduced them.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks x recoverable score, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Type contract by OPERATION | 57232, 50630, 51958 (+ type half of 56427) | copy/lookup vs split/extract vs convert each need a different python type; scorer compares value AND type | KNOWLEDGE / CONTRACT | tighten output contract, scoped by operation |
| 2 | Formula won't recalc headlessly | 53367 (ArrayFormula), 47741 (_xlfn/TEXTJOIN) | agent writes live array/exotic formula, "verifies" the text; LibreOffice recalc leaves it blank/stale | KNOWLEDGE | add missing knowledge + verify precondition |
| 3 | Reuse the pattern the sheet already shows | 56637, 59259 (+ helps 11842, 38332) | agent invents a variant / adds extra conditions instead of the pattern already present | KNOWLEDGE | add missing rule + narrowing exception |
| 4 | Don't invent #N/A/'-'/blank | 55931 | agent emits an error literal the instruction never names, where a number is expected | KNOWLEDGE / CONTRACT | add the converse of the existing #N/A rule |
| — | Ambiguous / inconsistent reference (SKIPPED) | 325-44, 450-9, 38332, 39046, 5192, 51359, 3911, 30709, 57090, 56996, 11842, 59743 | underspecified rule / GT inconsistent with visible data / volatile-source / locale quirk | CAPABILITY-GAP | not prose-fixable without hardcoding gold |

## Changes made this iteration (all in task_template.md; multiple distinct levers)
| cluster | edit class | file | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | Add missing knowledge (grounded in grader) | task_template.md (new "Formulas are graded by RECALCULATED value" block) | Plain formulas recalc — keep them; array/CSE, UNIQUE/FILTER/SORT, TEXTJOIN, AGGREGATE, volatile -> compute literal; ""->blank lowers coverage | Yes — cand_0001 added this same block and broke NONE of 55060/55667/58109 (plain formulas, kept) |
| 3 | Add missing rule + narrowing exception | task_template.md (new "Reuse the answer pattern" block) | Reproduce the formula/criteria already in/adjacent to the range; don't add extra bounds/filters/divisors; EXCEPTION: fix a formula the instruction calls broken (don't copy stale value) | Yes — exception protects 50051; empty-target/formatting tasks (55060/55667/58109/CF_11072/110-2) have no pattern present so rule doesn't fire |
| 1 | Tighten output contract, scoped by operation | task_template.md (3 new "Match the expected TYPE" bullets) | copy/lookup -> keep source cell's type; split/extract -> keep original text (str); convert/standardize a whole value -> real datetime/number + number_format | Yes — none fire on 73-45 (rich text, not copy/split/convert); rich-text bullet + verify(a) preserve CellRichText; 41297 lookup reinforced |
| 4 | Add converse of existing rule | task_template.md (clause on the #N/A bullet) | Write a computed value in every expected cell; only use #N/A/'-'/0/blank when the instruction names that form | Yes — 41297/57232/59259 name #N/A; 55060 blank-when-blank is instruction-required |
| 1-3 | Structural precondition (verify checklist a-b-c) | task_template.md (verify step) | Re-check recalc-value (not formula text) + reproduce any worked-example/existing value exactly before finishing; (a) keeps rich-text/formatting types | Yes — reissues the two checks that FIXED {47741,59259}; drops cand_0001's str-where-number "FAILURE" recheck that endangered 73-45 |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change -> the trace it targets)
- 53367 / 47741: wrote live ArrayFormula / _xlfn.TEXTJOIN verified only by formula text -> recalc block + verify(b) make them compute the literal bool/date-string. cand_0001 already fixed 47741 this way.
- 56637: had correct in-sheet =IF(ROWS(...)>$B$5,...) then regressed to a ROUNDUP/"" variant (91/146 coverage) -> reuse-pattern bullet: extend the same pattern across the range.
- 59259: added a calendar-year lower bound the visible SUMIFS lacks -> reuse-pattern "don't add extra conditions" + verify(c) reproduce the existing formula. cand_0001 fixed 59259 via the same example-repro check.
- 57232: coerced text->float / float->int, left a raw "=E36" (TYPE: 11 float where str, 5 int where float) -> copy/lookup keeps source cell's type.
- 50630: parsed an extracted "Due" substring into datetime (TYPE: 2 datetime where str; scorer said "where a str is expected, KEEP the original text") -> split/extract keeps original text.
- 51958: wrote string "09/08/21 10:06" where datetime expected (TYPE: str where datetime) -> convert/standardize a whole value -> real datetime + number_format.
- 55931: invented "#N/A" for 8 unmatched songs (TYPE: 8 str where int; instruction never names #N/A) -> don't-invent-error-literal clause.

## Blast-radius summary (all BOUNDED / ADDITIVE)
- No global decision/permission/refusal rule touched; prompt.md unchanged. Every edit adds a
  clarification that fires only under a stated operation/condition present in the failing cases.
- 73-45 (rich text): protected — type rules scoped to copy/split/convert (none apply), rich-text
  bullet + verify(a) kept. 50051 (corrective re-derivation): protected — no anti-fabrication rule
  re-added; reuse-pattern EXCEPTION covers "fix the broken formula, don't copy its stale value".
- Passing formula tasks 55060/55667/58109 use plain recalc-safe formulas explicitly kept;
  CF_11072/110-2 are formatting/filter answers untouched by value/type rules.

## Process & features used
- 5 parallel general-purpose read-only subagents (4 diagnosing the 21 failing traces in batches,
  1 analyzing the 8 passing tasks incl. the two cand_0001 regressed) -> synthesized into 4 clean
  clusters + the regression root-cause. Edits applied serially by me (surgical, single file).
- Read ./prior_iterations/cand_0001/{PROCESS.md,diff.patch} + LEDGER + JOURNAL: learned exactly
  which two edits caused broke={50051,73-45} and which fixed {47741,59259}; built on the latter,
  dropped/rescoped the former.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- Keep the type rules SCOPED BY OPERATION (copy/split/convert) — never re-add a global
  "text answer stays a plain string" rule; it broke 73-45.
- Keep prompt.md free of any "apply only stated operations / don't invent transforms" rule; it
  broke 50051's legitimate corrective re-derivation.
- Keep the recalc-to-literal block and the example-reproduction verify check (fixed 47741/59259).

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- 325-44/450-9 (unrecoverable expansion/full-sequence semantics), 38332/39046/57090 (reference =
  quirky cached-formula recalc / ambiguous "contains a part of" match), 5192 (two contradictory
  worked examples), 51359 (reference value exceeds the count of 1's present — inconsistent with
  visible data), 3911 (allocation underdetermined), 30709 (Excel locale DATEVALUE quirk), 56996
  (RANDBETWEEN source — moving target), 11842/59743 (task-specific half-day / blank-vs-"" edge).
  Prose can't fix these without hardcoding the gold answer -> would overfit and fail the gate.
